content: (The location is now Half-Moon Mill.) (Characters nearby (from nearest to furthest): Daegon, Serana)

Hert: Traveling so late, strangers? The road to Falkreath is treacherous after dark, with wolves and worse prowling the woods. Lydia: We've handled worse than wolves. We seek shelter for the night, if your mill has a spare bed or a warm corner. Hert: Shelter we have, and a fire too.
